game_start.intro: Wasan ya fara. Trump kwat da wando: {trump_suit} (katin nasara: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin Jamusanci Whist. {phase_info} Kuna riƙe da {hand_size} katunan. Kun kunna katin da '[play N]', inda N shine matsayinsa a hannunku (misali '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: SAURARA NA KOYARWA: wanda ya ci nasara a kowane wasa yana karɓar katin da aka buɗe kuma wanda ya rasa yana zana katin na gaba daga cikin katunan.
player_prompt.phase_playing: RABIN WASA: katin ya kare. Kowane tiki daga yanzu yana ƙidaya zuwa ga nasara.

next_card.playing_phase: Babu katin da aka bayar - an fara wasan.
next_card.deck_empty: Ƙungiyar ta zama fanko - babu katin da aka bayar.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsawa mara inganci. Yi amfani da '[play N]' don kunna katin Nth a hannunka.
invalid_move.bad_position: Wannan katin ba ya wanzu. Kuna riƙe da {hand_size} katunan.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Dole ne ku bi sahu kuma ku buga katin {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Ba za a iya yin amfani da wannan katin ba.

trick.won: Mai kunnawa {winner_id} ya ci nasara da dabarar tare da {card} .
trick.won_learning: Mai kunnawa {winner_id} ya ci nasara tare da {card} kuma ya ɗauki katin fuska.

phase.learning_complete: An gama wasan, an gama karatun, duk wata dabara da ta rage tana da muhimmanci wajen samun nasara.

draw.winner_received: Kun ci nasara kuma kun sami {card}.
draw.loser_received: Ka rasa dabarar kuma ka zana {card} daga bene.
draw.winner_preview: Katin na gaba da aka bayar shine {card}.

trick_view.empty: Babu katunan da aka buga har yanzu wannan abin zamba.
